call_points.text: Total bed capacity up 26% to 2,435; operational beds up 22% to 1,862.
Mature hospitals ARPOB about ₹70,000 versus about ₹59,000 for hospitals under five years old.
Mumbai EBITDA margin expected eventually above 20%, but management declined a precise margin estimate.
Fertility business expected to grow about 25% a year for at least three years.
About 900 beds in execution, expected to complete in about 2.5 years.
No debt and about ₹594 Cr cash; all expansion to be funded internally.
Q4 discharges, outpatient volumes and deliveries grew 18%, 19% and 22%.
Acquired Guwahati and Warangal units added 7%-8% of Q4 revenue growth.
Q4 payor mix: 47.5% cash and about 52% insurance.
Obstetrics rose to about 32% of revenue from 28%-30% historically.
International revenue flat at about ₹28.9 Cr as Bangladesh and other flows were disrupted.

guidance.statement: Revenue growth of around 20% in FY27

Additional investment of about ₹400-500 Cr in Gurugram projects over two years

Revenue growth in the 20% range in Q2FY27, above 20%

operating_notes.text: Q4 occupancy was 45.3% group-wide and about 52% in mature hospitals; management targets 56%-58% blended.
IVF contributed 3.7% of FY26 revenue (₹61.4 Cr) and about 4.1% in Q4; international patient revenue was about ₹28.9 Cr, broadly flat.
About 900 beds are in execution, including Gurugram; excluding Gurugram the pipeline is about 450 beds at ₹65-70 lakh per bed.
Total bed capacity 2,435 (+26% YoY) and operational beds 1,862 (+22% YoY) as of Q1FY27.
Mature hospitals (over five years) ARPOB about ₹70,000 versus about ₹59,000 for hospitals under five years old in Q1FY27.
Payor mix in Q1FY27: cash about 48%, insurance about 42%.

timeline.summary: On its 25 May 2026 Q4FY26 call, Rainbow guided FY27 revenue growth at around 20% and group occupancy at 56%-58%, with about 900 beds under execution and no debt.
On its Q1FY27 call (July 31, 2026), Rainbow guided to crossing ₹2,000 Cr revenue in FY27 and adding 2,500 beds over five years at about ₹2,200 Cr capex.
